column2: Nuestra Senora de la Etica Laxa
column3: South of Key Lento, off Abismo Key.
column4: 5 pieces. Golden Pendant under timbers at the middle opening; Golden Chalice by the south-side crate; Ancient Snuff Box beside the mast and purple sea fan; Battered Doubloon in the buried chest at the reef to the south; Ceremonial Spoon among the southeast timbers. Sell the set to Kenton.

column3: Dive marker south of Key Lento, closer to shore.
column4: 7 pieces. Dragon Pipe by the net across the broken hull; Purple Gemstone at a barrel farther along the hull; Ivory Saint and Pewter Gauntlet among the upright planks; Antique Candlestick by the anchor and barrels. Also find the Serpentine Statue and Stained Doubloon. Sell the set to Kenton.

column3: Island cluster southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Sell the set to Kenton. 6 finds: Ancient Ceremonial Mask; Ceremonial Plate; Golden Glove; Jade-Eye Cup; Rusty Doubloon; Sacred Necklace.

column3: Water southwest of the hooked islet, southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Jade-Lobe Tankard on the beam by the broken pot; Ceremonial Knife by the low crossbeam; Golden Statuette beside the fallen plank along the hull ribs; Golden Llama under crossed beams; Ceremonial Bowl by the coral-covered frame under the sloping timber. Also find the Shiny Doubloon. Sell the set to Kenton.

column3: Farther offshore east of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ornate Pocket Watch on the low detached deck beside sea fans; Silver Hip Flask by the square grate; Brass Spyglass below the tall slanted panel; Dividing Compass by a broken pot along the hull ribs; Santa Sierra Bell by parallel timbers at the curved hull. Also find the Worn Doubloon. Sell the set to Kenton.

column3: Off southern Belpoint, west of Bobcat Bight.
column4: 5 pieces at the deep-water dive site. 5 finds: Ancient Bracelet; Ancient Ingot; Avian Plate; Golden Fish; Lover's Grail. Kenton set; NOT one of 33 Underwater Discoveries.

column3: Reef off the west side of Bobcat Key.
column4: 6 pieces at the reef. 6 finds: Astrolabe; Captain's Whistle; Ceramic Pirate; Ivory Sundial; Naval Hourglass; Pirate's Buckle. Kenton set, NOT Underwater Discovery.
